**Valyu AI** is a search and content API platform specifically built for AI systems, agents, and large language models (LLMs) — not for human browsing.

## Core Purpose

Traditional search engines were designed with humans in mind, returning ranked links for people to click through. Valyu takes a fundamentally different approach: it returns structured, relevance-optimized content that AI systems can directly consume, reason over, and use for downstream tasks. The core idea is that if AI needs to reason accurately, it needs search results that are already filtered, structured, and context-aware — not raw links.[3]

## What It Does

Valyu provides a single unified Search API that connects AI agents and LLMs to knowledge across multiple domains, including the web, finance, academic research, medicine, and proprietary institutional data. Instead of requiring developers to stitch together multiple fragmented search pipelines, Valyu acts as a single abstraction layer. It supports real-time web search, full-text content extraction, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, and deep research automation — all through one endpoint.[1][2][3]

## DeepResearch Capability

One of Valyu's flagship offerings is **Valyu DeepResearch**, an AI research API targeted at enterprise knowledge work. It achieved **72.7% accuracy on the DRACO long-form research benchmark**, outperforming well-known systems like Perplexity Deep Research (70.5%), Claude Opus 4.6 (59.8%), Gemini Deep Research (59.0%), and OpenAI Deep Research o3 (52.1%) — while reportedly operating at less than half the cost of the next-best system.[2][4]

## Financial AI Focus

Valyu has earned a strong reputation specifically within financial AI, where agents need precise, time-sensitive structured data — things like stock prices, earnings reports, SEC filings, and trade data — blended seamlessly with web content. This makes it particularly valuable for finance-focused AI agents that need reliable factual grounding rather than approximate or hallucinated answers.[6]

## Company

Valyu is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in London, and its specializations span machine learning, LLMs, RAG, AI search, attribution, and context enrichment. It is trusted by leading AI development teams to power RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and knowledge-intensive applications.[1]
